reference.pathophysiology: Cholesterol supersaturation nucleates stones that obstruct and infect; trypsinogen activates intrapancreatically autodigesting fat into saponification (Grey Turner and Cullen ecchymoses), and KRAS driven ductal clones desmoplase into double duct obstruction.
